headline: Keep receipt-only validation independent of the browser runtime

items.title: Keep receipt-only validation independent of the browser runtime
items.insight: The reconciled complete-suite run hit the15second child timeout while receipt-only mode statically imported Playwright. The same test passed earlier; metadata validation does not need the browser runtime.
items.evidence: The existing real CLI refuses missing/mismatched theme evidence before copying, and reaches the expected theme errors even with Playwright resolution forbidden. Actual capture mode still produces reviewed source-bound images; full source and deployment acceptance remain mandatory.
